title: turns out @Jordan Fisher is feeding all of us!!!! #littleshopofhorror...
transcript: What's wild about this little shop casting is I would have bet jordan fisher was already seymour. Like, I had to google it to confirm that he hadn't already played the role, because in my brain it makes so much sense. Seymour is the perfect jordan fisher role and this production is made for him. But to put him opposite Nikki M. James is so perfect because Nikki is such an incredibly dynamic performer, and I feel like her audrey is going to be very different than some of the audreys we’ve seen before. I also really like the dynamic of having a slightly younger seymour and a slightly older audrey. I think it works really, really well in the context of the show, and it makes audrey's story so much more heartbreaking. Andy Karl Another one I had to google because it felt like he has obviously been the dentist before. Again, has not. Maybe it's because I saw him in teeth, and there's definitely a moment in teeth that feels so little shop coded. But in teeth we saw how good he is at balancing the humour and the horror, being frightening and also being hilarious. And that's what you need for the dentist. And again, I think having the dentist be older than seymour adds a lot. It changes the dynamics of what seymour is doing. To be clear, jordan is 31 He's not like a child, but he definitely reads younger, and I think that's A really fun dynamic to play with. So, yes, jordan and nikki both start on march 6th, and Andy starts march 10th. So looks like i'll be feeding those plants and heading back to little shop in march.
reasoning: The entire transcript is commentary on a newly announced casting (Jordan Fisher, Nikki M. James, Andy Karl starting in March) — the creator has not seen this production yet and is speculating about how the cast will perform.
